title: Geese Brooklyn Paramount Nov. 20th 2025
body: Overall great show. Was not expecting them to sound as good as they did. From what I had listened of Geese's songs leading up to the concert I thought they were a good band, but did not understand the hype. Seeing them live changed everything. Their complex sound rung clearly in the Paramount. The drum beats took us on an unpredictable journey sometimes with powerful raw kicks, and other times with a focus on unique percussions like use of a clave and cowbell. The guitar and bass shined through, complementing each other very well and sometimes seemed like communicating with each other with calls and responses. The guitar brought the show to highs and lows. interesting and funky drum beats
